"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Our determination to vigorously open foreign markets to American products is an opportunity for many small businesses to grow larger in the global economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Our approach to regulation — basing it on sound science to achieve goals that are technically feasible — will protect against job killing intrusions into small businesses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Our commitment to legal reform means protecting small businesses from the effects of frivolous lawsuits.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"We look to innovative entrepreneurs for the ingenuity and daring that can give us the next generation of technological progress.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Advances in health care, energy, and environmental protection are most likely to come from the men and women of small business.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"American innovation has twin engines: technology and small business, employing over half the private-sector work force.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The synergy of American technology and small business drove a world-wide economic transformation of the last quarter-century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"We need to encourage innovators by reforming and making permanent the Research and Development Tax Credit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
